builds.name: Haymaker ceiling
builds.summary: Center Haymaker deals 160+(.25+.0025 AD[statFormula=2])*Grit. Grit cap is 50% max HP; Bloodmail converts health into AD, multiplying both axes. Armor penetration cannot help center true damage.
builds.goal: Center Haymaker deals 160+(.25+.0025 AD[statFormula=2])*Grit. Grit cap is 50% max HP; Bloodmail converts health into AD, multiplying both axes. Armor penetration cannot help center true damage.

Passive: Sett stores [100]% of damage taken as Grit, up to [(0.5) × Stat(12)]. Grit decays quickly [4] seconds after the damage was taken.

Active: Sett consumes all Grit, gaining a [100]% Grit consumed Shield decaying over [3] seconds. Sett then delivers a massive punch, dealing [80 / 100 / 120 / 140 / 160] plus [0.25 + (0.0025) × AD[statFormula=2]] Grit consumed true damage to enemies in the center (max @f1@ damage).
